articles.title: Why Jim Cramer’s quantum panic isn’t rattling bitcoin as price holds steady around $64,000
articles.snippet: Jim Cramer says he's dumping his bitcoin over quantum computing fears, but his track record of crypto and bank calls has buoyed the crypto community.

articles.title: Jim Cramer plans to sell his Bitcoin over quantum fears as BTC rises 1.6%
articles.snippet: The CNBC personality said he’ll sell his Bitcoin holdings due to fears about quantum computing, as some cryptocurrency investors celebrated, referencing the popular “inverse Cramer” meme.
